channel.title: Wire — DevOps
channel.description: DevOps from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Presentation: Continuous Delivery for Foundational Platforms
item.description: Ian Nowland discusses why conventional CI/CD practices break down for stateful, core infrastructure. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Optimizing Kubernetes pods for reliability with topology spread constraints
item.description: Topology spread constraints let you determine how Kubernetes spreads pod replicas across failure domains, such as availability zones and regions. (1 source: sreweekly)

item.title: Routeup – stable local HTTPS URLs and opt-in public tunnels
item.description: I built Routeup around a simple idea: local apps should use their real names. It was inspired by Portless , but I also wanted built-in public tunneling, selective path exposure, request inspection, and live logs. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Running a Java Spring Boot app on a 512 MB VPS with lightweight monitoring
item.description: I wanted to see how a fairly representative Java Spring Boot application behaves on a very small VPS, especially the difference between configured heap and actual JVM process memory. (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: Microsoft Moves AI Governance From Policy to Runtime Enforcement
item.description: Microsoft has outlined an AI governance architecture spanning nine governance domains and four functions: policy, control, visibility, and proof. (1 source: infoq)
